Ravi K.: Hit a problem this morning where strict schema enforcement rejected a legacy pin during a deploy. We need a gentler migration pattern.
Elena V.: Agreed. My idea: a thin adapter that can map a bounded set of v2 semantics into v1-safe fields at read-time. No mandatory backfill.
Tom S.: Example mapping?
Elena V.: e.g. `meta.v2.placement.hint` -> translate to `affinity` tag if `auto_map_v2` is enabled on that runtime. If not enabled, leave `meta.v2` untouched.
Priya N.: Also expose validation modes: `permissive` (ignore unknown), `warn` (metric+warning), `strict` (reject). Owners opt into strict after canary.
Ravi K.: How do runtimes signal support?
Tom S.: Capability bits in manifest + runtime header. Example manifest: `capabilities:["schema:v2","placement_v2"]`. Runtime sends `X-Runtime-Capabilities: schema:v2;placement_v2`.
ops-bot: Deploy-bot: adapter canary started (id: adp-2026-07) 3/10 pods healthy.
Elena V.: Routing safety: only allow mapping to affect placement if target node advertises `placement_v2`. Otherwise adapter returns a v1-safe plan.
Priya N.: Add "shadow evaluation" — run v2 decision logic in shadow against live traffic, collect diffs but don't apply. Helps catch behavioral changes.
Ravi K.: Telemetry we need: `schema_adapter_mapped`, `schema_diff_rate`, `shadow_mismatch_pct`, `schema_rejects_strict`.
Tom S.: For exports/imports: always include top-level v1 fields plus a `serialized_v2` blob. Importers that understand v2 prefer it.
Elena V.: Safety rule: unknown v2 keys may never alter placement/cost unless manifest contains explicit capability `placement_v2`. Adapter can map only when allowed.
Priya N.: Testing: run shadow evaluation for 100k+ requests per canary, compare placement outputs, measure false-positive rate. Add SDK parser warnings in `warn` mode.
Ravi K.: Sounds good. Can someone draft a one-pager with adapter mapping table, handshake headers, validation modes, and the shadowing plan?
Elena V.: I'll put a draft RFC together and include a small mapping table and sample payloads.
ops-bot: Note: adapter canary health updated: 7/10 ready after restart.
Priya N.: I'll own the canary harness and dashboards. Ping infra and SDK teams for review.
